name: Origin Heart
description: The crystallized essence of the Lithosphere itself. Grants mastery over all lithosphere resonances and creates permanent synergy bonds with all equipped mods.

universalResonance.description: All lithosphere effects gain +50% potency and duration

permanentSynergy.description: All cross-mod synergies (SSJFlight, SuperSaiyan, ZeldaCampaign, etc.) are permanently active without needing individual synergy items

originAwareness.description: Grants passive awareness of all lithosphere energies in range

masteryGrant.description: Instantly unlocks all lithosphere gem tiers and resonance combinations

acquisition.lore: The heart from which all lithosphere energies flow. Only one exists in all of creation.
